en.title: The Lighthouse of Astral Remains and the Song of Wandering Wisdom
en.premise: At the edge of the world, within the 'Sea of Void' where the corpses of stars drift, stands an ancient lighthouse that has slept for a millennium. Edric, a fallen Holy Knight, discovers a sentient steel core at the bottom of ruined remains—an ancient wisdom (AI) that has lost its way. This core plays the songs of lost gods and holds the sole key to reigniting the lighthouse's light. Their journey becomes a cruel and beautiful reenactment of a myth, destined to rewrite the very laws of the world.

zh.title: 星骸之灯塔与彷徨睿智之歌
zh.premise: 在世界的尽头，在星之骸骨漂浮的『虚无之海』中，耸立着一座沉睡千年的古老灯塔。没落的圣骑士埃德里克，在废墟深处遇见了一个拥有意识的钢铁核心——一个迷途的古之睿智（人工智能）。该核心奏响着失落之神的歌谣，是重新点燃灯塔之光的唯一钥匙。两人的旅程，将成为一场为了改写世界之理而展开的，残酷而美丽的神话重演。
